description: This Java class defines the entity 'TaxGroup' in the context of the Fineract project, specifically related to tax domain logic. It manages tax group data, including creation, updates, and retrieval of associated mappings.

classes.name: TaxGroup
classes.description: Entity representing a group of taxes, encapsulating logic for creation, update, and management of associated tax components.

methods.name: createTaxGroup
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new TaxGroup with provided name and mappings.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the TaxGroup's name and its tax component mappings based on provided commands and mappings data.

methods.name: findOneBy
methods.description: Finds an existing TaxGroupMappings within this TaxGroup by matching IDs; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getTaxGroupMappings
methods.description: Returns the set of mappings associated with this TaxGroup.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the TaxGroup.
